category: Category B — Tenant and Landlord Disputes
name: ₹25,000 deposit not returned after vacating
expected: Explains deposit refund rights under Model Tenancy Act / Transfer of Property Act; suggests 15-day notice.
prompt: My landlord in Jaipur is refusing to return my ₹25,000 security deposit. I vacated 20 days ago. What can I do?
raw_response:
Hello! I understand how stressful it is to have your security deposit withheld unfairly, and I am here to help you navigate this situation.

### | Your Situation
You vacated your rented premises in Jaipur 20 days ago, and your landlord is wrongfully refusing to return your security deposit of ₹25,000. The key issue is the unauthorized withholding of your rightful funds without valid deductions.

### | Your Legal Position
- Under the Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (and applicable state guidelines), the security deposit for residential premises is typically capped, and landlords are required to refund the security deposit at the time of taking over vacant possession after making only valid deductions agreed under the tenancy agreement.
- Under Section 108(m) and (o) of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, a tenant is bound to restore the property in as good condition as received, subject only to reasonable wear and tear. A landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for natural aging or normal usage without explicit contractual justification.
- Under Section 6 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963, and general legal principles, forceful or unjust deprivation of property and financial assets without due process of law is unlawful.

### | Practical Next Steps
1. Gather evidence: Collect your written tenancy agreement, rent receipts, bank statements proving deposit payment, and timestamped photographs or videos of the apartment's condition at the time you vacated.
2. Send a written demand notice: Issue a formal written demand notice to your landlord requesting the immediate return of your ₹25,000 security deposit, granting a clear period of 15 days to comply before legal escalation.
3. Appropriate forum: If the landlord fails to respond, approach the local Rent Authority or file a consumer complaint for deficiency of service, or initiate summary recovery proceedings through appropriate legal channels in Jaipur.

### ℹ️ Information I still need from you
Do you have a written rental agreement that specifies the exact terms for returning the security deposit, and did you cause any structural damage beyond reasonable wear and tear before leaving?

citations.title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
citations.description: In the absence of a contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for other than agricultural or manufacturing purposes is deemed to be month-to-month, terminable on 15 days' notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.

citations.title: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property without due process
citations.description: If any person is dispossessed without his consent of immovable property otherwise than in due course of law, he or any person claiming through him may, by suit, recover possession thereof notwithstanding any other title that may be set up.
